_doc: Size budgets of the published images (devcontainer-<name>), in MiB (1024 * 1024 bytes), read by scripts/check-image-size.py. max_uncompressed_mib gates every pull request in ci.yml (devcontainer-build): docker image inspect .Size of the linux/amd64 image on the runner's classic overlay2 store, the sum of the files in its layers; over budget fails the build. max_compressed_mib is reported, never enforced, when build-containers.yml publishes: config plus layers of the linux/amd64 manifest in the registry, what a pull downloads. Raising a budget is a reviewed edit to this file: change the number and its reason in the same pull request and say what grew. See docs/IMAGE_PUBLISHING.md.
